question: GST Day marks the nationwide rollout of the Goods and Services Tax on 1st July 2017. Which of the following is not one of the GST tax slabs?
solution:
The Correct Answer is __**15%**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• GST Day: 1 July.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

 
• 
 
**GST Day** is observed on **1st July**, marking the **nationwide rollout** of the **Goods and Services Tax (GST)** on **1st July 2017**.

 
 
• 
 
The **first celebration** of GST Day was on **1st July 2018**, introduced by the **Ministry of Finance**.

 
 
• 
 
The **GST Council** was established in **September 2016** under **Article 279 of the Constitution**.

 
 
• 
 
**GST has five main**A

 
 
• 
 
** tax slabs**: **0%**, **5%**, **12%**, **18%**, and **28%**.
